cases.name: an-offset-that-does-not-say-how-far
cases.description: of= turns a date generator from a draw into an offset, and an offset without a distance is only half a sentence. There is no sensible default: zero would make the two columns identical and one day would be an invention.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="In"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-02-01"/></sequence><sequence name="Out"><gen type="date" of="In"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-offset-written-largest-first
cases.description: 10..3 is a typo for 3..10, and swapping the bounds silently would hide it. To measure BACKWARDS the config makes both bounds negative, which is a different thing said a different way.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="In"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-02-01"/></sequence><sequence name="Out"><gen type="date" of="In" plus="10..3d"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-offset-in-a-unit-that-does-not-exist
cases.description: The units are the ones step= already uses — s, m, h, d, w, mo, y — so a quarter is written as 3mo. A bare number means days.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="In"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-02-01"/></sequence><sequence name="Out"><gen type="date" of="In" plus="3q"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-offset-that-also-bounds-its-own-draw
cases.description: from= and to= place a date generator's OWN draw and say nothing once of= has placed it relative to another column. Ignoring them is the silent failure this exists to prevent: a config that asks for June dates and gets January ones is right about what it asked for and wrong about what it got.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="In"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-02-01"/></sequence><sequence name="Out"><gen type="date" of="In" plus="7d" from="2026-06-01"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-offset-reading-a-column-that-is-not-declared-above-it
cases.description: An offset is built in declaration order out of a column that already exists, so of= takes the same rule parent=, a running total and a statistic take. The code is shared with those deliberately — the same rule with the same fix.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Out"><gen type="date" of="In" plus="7d"/></sequence><sequence name="In"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-02-01"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Out}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-distance-with-nothing-to-measure-from
cases.description: plus= belongs to the offset and nothing else reads it, so a lone plus="3d" was dropped in silence and the column came out as ordinary drawn dates. "Shift this column by three days" is the natural misreading of it, and step= and weekdays= are already refused on a drawn date for exactly this reason.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-02-01" plus="3d"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{D}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-offset-of-a-repeating-column
cases.description: of= names a column that repeats, so each cell holds a list of dates rather than one date
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="date" from="2020-01-01" to="2020-12-31" repeat="2" separator="|"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="date" of="A" plus="3d"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: plus-reads-a-column-declared-below
cases.description: plus="Dur m" reads Dur row by row while the offset is built, so Dur has to be declared above it, as of= does.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Start"><gen type="date" from="2026-03-02" to="2026-03-09"/></sequence><sequence name="End"><gen type="date" of="Start" plus="Dur m"/></sequence><sequence name="Dur"><gen type="number" value="10..60"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{End}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: plus-reads-a-column-that-repeats
cases.description: A repeat= column holds a list in each cell, and a distance is one number.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Start"><gen type="date" from="2026-03-02" to="2026-03-09"/></sequence><sequence name="Gaps"><gen type="number" value="1..5" repeat="1..2"/></sequence><sequence name="End"><gen type="date" of="Start" plus="Gaps d"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{End}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: plus-names-a-column-with-an-unknown-unit
cases.description: min is not a unit: the units are s, m, h, d, w, mo, y.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Start"><gen type="date" from="2026-03-02" to="2026-03-09"/></sequence><sequence name="Dur"><gen type="number" value="10..60"/></sequence><sequence name="End"><gen type="date" of="Start" plus="Dur min"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{End}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: plus-reads-a-column-of-whole-numbers
cases.description: A distance column declared above and holding one number per row is accepted, a leading minus and a pool reference's field included.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><pool name="R" count="2"><sequence name="gap"><gen type="number" value="1..5"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="Ref"><gen type="pool" value="R"/></sequence><sequence name="Start"><gen type="date" from="2026-03-02" to="2026-03-09"/></sequence><sequence name="Dur"><gen type="number" value="10..60"/></sequence><sequence name="End"><gen type="date" of="Start" plus="-Dur h"/></sequence><sequence name="Next"><gen type="date" of="Start" plus="Ref.gap w"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{End}} ${{Next}}</data></line></block></tdc>
